# Tailbone Treatment Clinic

> Specialist, non-surgical treatment for tailbone (coccyx) pain, also called coccydynia or coccygodynia, led by Dr Rajveer Singh (BPT, Fellowship in Orthopaedic Rehabilitation, Apollo Hospital Chennai). Clinic in Vasant Kunj, New Delhi, India, plus online video consultations worldwide. Lucknow clinic opening soon. The Bengaluru clinic has closed.

Key facts:
- Conditions treated: coccydynia (tailbone pain), subluxed or dislocated coccyx, tailbone pain after a fall or injury, after pregnancy or childbirth, pain when sitting, chronic tailbone discomfort.
- Approach: assessment and diagnosis, hands-on Internal Manipulation of the coccyx and surrounding muscles, posture and seating advice, exercises and follow-up. Surgery is rarely needed.
- Address: 150A/09, Shanti Apartment, Kishangarh, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi 110070, India.
- Hours (by appointment): Monday–Friday 10:00–17:00, Saturday 10:00–15:00, Sunday 08:00–15:00 (IST).
- Fees: consultation ₹800 (in clinic or online); follow-up within 7 days ₹500.
- Book: https://tailbone.netlify.app/book · WhatsApp or phone +91 98866 88323 · contact@tailbonetreatment.com
- Medical information on this site is general and not a substitute for an examination.

## Articles

- [Tailbone pain, explained in pictures](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/tailbone-pain-explained-in-pictures.html): A visual guide to coccydynia. Why sitting loads the tailbone, how it gets injured, how to tell it from other pain, what sitting and standing X-rays show, and how treatment is stepped up.
- [Why "bone setting" for tailbone pain can be dangerous](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/tailbone-bone-setting-risks.html): Pressing or massaging the tailbone from outside, without knowing which way it has shifted, can push an inward-displaced coccyx deeper into the pelvis. Dr Rajveer Singh explains the risk.
- [Kegel exercises can make tailbone pain worse](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/kegel-exercises-and-tailbone-pain.html): Kegels and "butt-squeezing" are often suggested for pelvic pain. Dr Rajveer Singh explains why they can pull an inward-shifted or fractured coccyx further out of place, and what to do instead.
- [A displaced tailbone: why the direction of the shift matters](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/tailbone-subluxation-inward-or-outward.html): A displaced coccyx can be pushed inward into the pelvis or outward. Dr Rajveer Singh explains why the direction must be known first, how treatment differs, and how one patient recovered.
- [How coccydynia is treated, and how often each treatment works](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/coccydynia-treatment-ladder.html): Tailbone pain is treated in steps, from better sitting and hands-on care to injections and, rarely, surgery. What each step involves and the success rates reported in research.
- [Tailbone pain in numbers](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/coccydynia-facts-and-figures.html): How common is tailbone pain, who gets it, what causes it and how often treatment works: the key figures from medical research, each with its source.
- [8 ways to sit more comfortably with tailbone pain](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/sitting-with-tailbone-pain.html): Desk job, long drives or a hard classroom bench? Small changes to how and how long you sit can take a lot of pressure off a sore coccyx.
- [Tailbone pain after having a baby](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/tailbone-pain-after-pregnancy.html): Many new mothers find that sitting to feed their baby is surprisingly painful. Here is why childbirth can affect the coccyx, and how it is treated.
- [When tailbone pain needs urgent attention](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/tailbone-pain-red-flags.html): Most tailbone pain is mechanical and treatable without surgery. A few warning signs, though, mean you should see a doctor quickly. Here is what they are.
- [What happens at a coccydynia consultation (and how to prepare)](https://tailbone.netlify.app/blog/what-happens-at-your-consultation.html): Nervous about your first visit for tailbone pain? Here is what to expect, step by step, and how to prepare so you get the most from the appointment.
